import os,json
from pathlib import Path
aliases=["/root/iptvpn_bot","/etc/iptvpn-bot","/root/project-secrets/iptvpn_bot"]
out={"refs":{},"audit_pid":os.getpid(),"audit_ppid":os.getppid()}
for old in aliases:out["refs"][old]=[]
for p in Path("/proc").iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdecimal():continue
 pid=int(p.name)
 if pid in (os.getpid(),os.getppid()):continue
 try:
  env=(p/"environ").read_bytes()
  hits=[x for x in aliases if x.encode() in env]
  if not hits:continue
  comm=(p/"comm").read_text().strip()
  for x in hits:out["refs"][x].append({"pid":pid,"comm":comm,"cwd_in_iptvpn":os.readlink(str(p/"cwd")).startswith("/srv/projects/iptvpn-bot") if (p/"cwd").exists() else None})
 except OSError:pass
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
